title: Symbol instance properties: name, color effect, loop mode
description: When a SymbolInstance is selected, users need to set: (1) Instance Name (for AS2 addressability: _root.myClip.gotoAndPlay(2)) — stored as instanceName on SymbolInstance; (2) Color Effect — None/Brightness/Tint/Alpha/Advanced; each mode has its own CXFORM parameters; update SymbolInstance.colorEffect (already has tint/alpha). (3) Loop mode — Loop/Play Once/Single Frame + First Frame number (for graphic symbols). Show these in a Properties panel or in the existing right-panel area when a SymbolInstance is selected. Also add instanceName to the SWF compile path: PlaceObject2 with HasName flag (0x20) and name string. See docs/07-symbols-and-library.md, packages/core/src/engine/types.ts SymbolInstance.
